periods.time: After the Or-Gaule war, in Vermillion Palace
periods.label: 复健中的幼体一辉
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Vermillion royal family by engagement; Kurogane family

status.current: alive but physically reduced to about ten years old after near death against Or-Gaule
status.condition: training to adapt his swordsmanship to a child-sized body while waiting months for cellular recovery

relationships.stella-vermillion: Fiancee; both recover from the Or-Gaule war and look toward future threats.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Younger sister and healer who saved his life after the battle.
relationships.or-gaule: Enemy whose final battle killed Ikki briefly and caused severe cellular loss.

periods.summary: Ikki survives the Or-Gaule conflict only because Shizuku arrives under League summons and heals him after he briefly dies. The damage cannot be fully restored immediately: his body shrinks to roughly a ten-year-old's size and his strength, stamina, reach and skin durability drop accordingly. Rather than despairing, Ikki treats the setback as a training opportunity and resolves to refine technique beyond the limits of his old physique, aiming to fight effectively in the temporary child body and eventually surpass his former self.

key_events.summary: Resumes sword practice in Vermillion Palace and reframes his weakened body as a chance to polish technique.

abilities: swordsmanship based on the Twin-Wings style
